rules.decade: The workbook's own 'Decade' column: >=2020 '2020s', >=2010 '2010s', else 'Older'. Compute a true decade with floor(y/10)*10 if needed.
rules.popularity: The workbook's own 'popularity' column: streams >= 1,000,000,000 'Mega Hit', >= 500,000,000 'Hit', else 'Normal'.
rules.text: Names are exactly as in the file. 70 track names and 48 artist strings contain the Unicode replacement character U+FFFD (e.g. 'Beyonc��', 'ROSAL�'); the original accented letters were lost upstream and are not guessed here. Some names are also truncated in the source.
rules.nonTextTitles: Six titles were stored by Excel as numbers or a time (505, 69, 2055, 212, 295 and 10:35:00); they are written back as the text '505', '69', '2055', '212', '295' and '10:35'.
rules.suspicious: Kept as-is: 'Que Vuelvas' (Carin Leon, Grupo Frontera) has streams = 2,762, far below every other track (next lowest 1,365,184) despite being in 763 Spotify playlists. It is very likely a data error but the true value cannot be proven, so it is not changed.
